body: [Learn about sector ETFs](https://www.schwab.com/etfs/types/sector-etfs). Forward earnings growth is relatively weak given the strong growth expectations in Information Technology and other cyclical sectors like Consumer Discretionary and Industrials. **Risks:** Materials is a highly cyclical sector with earnings closely tied to global economic growth and industrial production. Investors who want to make tactical shifts in their portfolios can use Schwab Sector Views ratings as a resource. [Learn about sector ETFs](https://www.schwab.com/etfs/types/sector-etfs).
